cohort.definition: Same 20 published GSIS IDs with at least 200 accepted E throws and ten E games in each season; fixed membership across team changes.
cohort.limitation: CP-related survivor-selected regular-use actors, not position-certified or all NFL quarterbacks.
cohort.name: observed abbreviated source label; no inferred full names

denominators.cpoe_pp: Mean supplied CPOE on the exact frozen in-cohort E keys.
denominators.completion_pct: 100 times mean complete_pass on those identical E keys.
denominators.epa_per_dropback: Recorded played passes, sacks and scramble-runs; no CP, EPA-availability, E-game, penalty or description filter. Shared possession-team play value.
denominators.actor_games: Sums of actor-game counts are not distinct NFL-game counts.
denominators.sack_avoidance_pct: 100*(D minus recorded sacks)/D. S scrambles already enter D.
denominators.combined_opportunities: O is D disjoint union R; R is recorded non-scramble actor runs, including aborted/lateral plays, not designed runs.
denominators.run_contribution: Sum of role play EPA divided by N_O; usage plus shared observed value. Do not add to EPA per D.
denominators.run_share_pct: 100 times role count/N_O; percent, not fraction.
denominators.role_mean_epa: Sum of role play EPA/role count; diagnostic only. No role opportunities gives null, not zero ability.
denominators.recorded_composition: Disjoint other D passes, sacks, scramble-runs and R over O; do not stack overlapping diagnostic flags.

uncertainty.epa: Existing approximate 95% marginal conditional actor-game-sampling sensitivities, centered on the deletion mean; not paired-player, difference or rank intervals.
uncertainty.study_associations: Existing approximate 95% conditional whole-NFL-game working-model sensitivities; annual season-specific deviations centered on the full estimate.
uncertainty.limits: No demonstrated NFL coverage, causal isolation, forecast, useful player separation or CPOE superiority; persistent context, serial dependence, survivor selection and unknown CP model vintage remain.
uncertainty.unavailable: Null interval limits mean unavailable, not zero; preserve interval status.
uncertainty.run_contribution: Copied approximate 95% marginal conditional actor O-game ratio sensitivities, centered on the deletion mean; not player-difference, rank or season-change intervals.
uncertainty.run_shares_and_role_means: No intervals estimated. Zero observed count/share/contribution is distinct from null unavailable per-run mean.
uncertainty.marginal_collapsed: No observed deletion variation, not certainty.
uncertainty.sack_and_rush_studies: Whole-NFL-game Fisher sensitivities; each season uses its own replicate mean. Annual strata contain 223 and 208 contributing games, not independent observations.
uncertainty.overlap: S already enters D EPA and avoidance; the six views share evidence. No cross-study superiority test or isolated mobility/overall score.

attribution.source_notices: Retain applicable upstream notices and disclaimers; no endorsement is implied. Schedule reference has separate upstream notices.
attribution.transformation_notice: Aggregated exact frozen eligible throws to player-season CPOE and completion means; copied existing raw-EPA summaries and conditional intervals. No new uncertainty estimation. Added existing recorded sack-avoidance/run-contribution aggregates and conditional sensitivities; derived role shares/composition from their accepted counts. No new estimation.
